new_jobs.description:
Sr Director of Product, Client Engagement Group

At Squarespace, we empower our product teams to solve hard problems in ways that our customers love and strengthen our business. As Senior Director of Product for the Client Engagement Group (CEG), you will lead the product strategy and execution for Squarespace's customer engagement platform: the CRM, email campaigns, automations, and transactional communications that enable our merchants to build lasting customer relationships and grow their businesses on Squarespace.

The Client Engagement Group sits at the center of Squarespace's growth strategy. Our marketing tools are a critical lever in increasing product attach, reducing merchant churn, and building a differentiated position in the service commerce landscape. You will own the vision for transforming our current communications offering into a unified customer engagement hub… one that competes with best-in-class tools while leveraging Squarespace's unique data and ecosystem advantages.

You will report directly to the President of Squarespace and serve as a member of the Product leadership team. You will have the option of working on-site (hybrid) at our NYC headquarters or remotely within the U.S.

You’ll Get To…

Define and drive the multi-year product vision and strategy for CEG - spanning CRM, email campaigns, automations, transactional communications, and emerging channels including SMS - with a clear line of sight to revenue growth and platform impact
Own the Email Campaigns business line end-to-end: report on revenue performance, develop engagement and GTM strategies, and lead roadmap decisions in close partnership with commercial and marketing stakeholders
Build toward a competitive, full-featured customer engagement platform by prioritizing investments in business CRM, transactional automations, flexible communication channels, and advanced segmentation that meet the sophisticated needs of today's service sellers
Lead, grow, and mentor a team of product managers across multiple product lines, setting a high bar for hypothesis-driven development, roadmap rigor, and customer-centricity
Partner with Engineering and Design functional leads to deliver outcomes across the team; step in to remove blockers and maintain velocity on high-priority initiatives
Collaborate across the Squarespace ecosystem - with Commerce, Growth, Financial Solutions, and GTM - to ensure CEG products are deeply integrated into the broader platform
Champion the use of Squarespace data and AI to create smarter automation flows, personalized outreach, and differentiated customer engagement experiences that competitors cannot easily replicate
Shape the process, craft, and standards for senior product leadership at Squarespace

Who We’re Looking For

12+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent building and scaling customer engagement, CRM, marketing, or communications products
5+ years leading and developing teams of product managers in complex, multi-product environments
Deep familiarity with the customer engagement and email service provider landscape; informed perspective on what it takes to compete with and differentiate from best-in-class marketing and CRM tools
Demonstrated ability to own a revenue-generating product line with accountability for business outcomes, not just product delivery
Strong strategic instincts paired with a bias for execution; comfortable operating at the intersection of vision-setting and unblocking day-to-day team work
Excellent communicator and cross-functional partner with the credibility to influence senior leadership and align stakeholders across product, engineering, commercial, and marketing functions
Experience applying hypothesis-driven development and experimentation to accelerate product-market fit and grow adoption

new_jobs.title: Product Alliance Director, Technology Partnerships - Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery
new_jobs.description:
Treasure AI

Treasure AI is the agentic experience platform built to acquire, retain, and grow your most valuable customers. Powered by AI, Treasure AI is shaped by human creativity and always-on through continuous, context-driven action.

Furthermore, Treasure AI employees are enthusiastic, data-driven, and customer-obsessed. We are a team of drivers—self-starters who take initiative, anticipate needs, and proactively jump in to solve problems. Our actions reflect our values of honesty, reliability, openness, and humility.

Your Role

Treasure AI is seeking a Product Alliance Director, Technology Partnerships to own and deepen our strategic relationships with key cloud data warehouse and analytics vendors — including Snowflake, Databricks, and Google BigQuery. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of product, partnerships, and go-to-market, reporting into the Product Management organization.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of technical depth, business acumen, and AI fluency. You can hold a credible architecture conversation with a solutions engineer in the morning, and present a compelling joint value proposition to a C-suite partner in the afternoon — all without leaning on R&D resources until a truly deep engineering discussion is warranted.
You will be the primary product point of contact for Treasure AI's data warehouse ecosystem partners, driving alignment on joint roadmaps, co-sell motions, and integration strategy. You will also work closely with GTM to map ICP target accounts, identify expansion opportunities, and help translate technical differentiation into revenue impact.

Responsibilities

Partnership Ownership

Serve as the primary product liaison for Treasure AI's relationships with Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, and other strategic data platform partners.
Own the joint product roadmap and integration backlog with each partner, ensuring Treasure AI's capabilities are deeply embedded in partner ecosystems.
Negotiate and align on co-sell agreements, marketplace listings, and technical partnership tiers.
Represent Treasure AI at partner events, technical working groups, and executive business reviews.

Technical Engagement

Lead architecture-level discussions with partner SEs and technical leadership — fluently covering data ingestion, query federation, identity resolution, and AI/ML pipelines.
Independently evaluate integration opportunities and write functional specifications without requiring R&D involvement in initial scoping phases.
Monitor partner platform roadmaps and assess impact on Treasure AI's product strategy and competitive positioning.

GTM & Revenue Enablement

Collaborate with Sales and Solutions Engineering to map ICP target accounts where joint partner motions create the highest revenue leverage.
Develop co-marketing assets, joint solution briefs, and sales plays that help field teams position Treasure AI within the partner ecosystem.
Define and track partnership KPIs including influenced pipeline, co-sell deal counts, and integration adoption metrics.

AI-Native Execution

Self-sufficiently create high-quality assets — branded decks, one-pagers, competitive briefs, and demo narratives — using AI-assisted tooling.
Rapidly prototype integration concepts and partner use cases to validate technical feasibility before engaging engineering resources.
Champion AI-fluent ways of working across the partnerships function, setting the bar for speed and output quality.

Job Requirements

7+ years of experience in product management, technical partnerships, or solutions engineering — ideally in a B2B SaaS or data/AI company.
Demonstrated experience working with one or more of: Snowflake, Databricks, Google BigQuery, or comparable cloud data platforms.
Strong technical foundation — able to understand and discuss data architecture, APIs, identity graphs, and AI/ML pipelines at a conceptual-to-functional level.
Proven business acumen — experience building joint business cases, co-sell motions, or partner GTM programs that influenced revenue.
AI fluency — actively uses AI tools in your daily workflow; can rapidly prototype, draft, and iterate using LLM-based tooling.
Exceptional communication skills — able to adapt from a whiteboard with architects to a boardroom with executives.
High degree of independence — comfortable making decisions and driving outcomes without heavy process scaffolding or cross-functional hand-holding.

Nice to Have

Prior experience in a CDP, customer data platform, or marketing technology company.
Familiarity with data clean rooms, zero-copy architectures, or composable CDP patterns.
Experience working on Snowflake Native Apps, Databricks Marketplace listings, or Google Cloud Partner Advantage programs.
Background in solutions consulting or pre-sales technical roles.

Why This Role

Direct impact: You will own relationships with some of the most strategically important names in the modern data stack and shape how Treasure AI's platform integrates into their ecosystems.
AI-first team: Treasure AI is building the next generation of customer intelligence with AI at the core — you'll be working at the frontier, not applying AI as an afterthought.
Visibility: This role operates at the intersection of Product, GTM, and C-suite partner relationships — high exposure, high accountability, high reward.
Autonomy: We hire people we trust. You'll have the latitude to move fast, experiment, and build the partnerships function in your own image.

Physical Requirements

Working out of the Mountain View, California or New York, New York office according to our “Global Hybrid Working Policy.”

The schedule requires being on-site in Mountain View during the first work week of every month, followed by our standard 3-day-a-week in-office hybrid schedule for the rest of the month.

Travel Requirements

Requires peaks of 50% travel to visit clients.

Perks And Benefits (US)

Our benefit package showcases our culture of care and empathy with
Comprehensive medical, dental, vision plans and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Competitive compensation packages
Company paid life insurance 3x salary
Company paid short- and long-term disability coverage
Retirement planning (401K) with 4% company match
Restricted Stock Units (RSU)
Flexible Time Off (FTO)
Up to 26 weeks paid parental leave including a post-partum night nurse
Comprehensive support and access to care for everyone, everywhere through Carrot - our global reproductive health and family-building benefit.

Our Dedication To You

We value and promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our business and at all levels. Success comes from acknowledging, welcoming, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Diverse representation alone is not the desired outcome. We also strive to create an inclusive culture that encourages growth, ownership of your role, and achieving innovation in new and unique ways. Your voice will be heard, and we will help amplify it.

Agencies And Recruiters

We cannot consider your candidate(s) without a contract in place. Any resumes received without having an active agreement will be considered gratis referrals to us. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation!

This description captures the core of the role today. As we adopt AI and new ways of working, responsibilities may evolve, and we encourage team members to take initiative, lean into change, and help expand the impact of their role beyond what’s listed here.

Treasure AI moves marketing and data teams beyond legacy martech SaaS toward autonomous, ROI-driven AI agents that operate continuously, while keeping the human in the loop. With built-in governance, Treasure AI is powered by an always-up-to-date understanding of each customer for AI to act on.

The result is always-on marketing execution that compounds over time: smarter engagement, stronger retention, and measurable growth.

Treasure AI’s agentic experience platform is available across web, mobile, and desktop — bringing your customer intelligence to every workflow, wherever your team works.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Software Engineering - Machine Learning Simulations
new_jobs.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City (opening Summer 2026), you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart's Machine Learning and Simulations Platform team builds and operates the infrastructure behind ML model training, features engineering, inference, and marketplace simulation. Our simulation platform answers one question before any change reaches a borrower: what would this new ML model, price, or fee have produced for real applicants? It replays historical data through production pricing logic in isolated environments, and it is now the shared tool every machine learning team at Upstart uses to size the impact of a launch. Our priorities are reliability teams can bet a launch on, fidelity to production we can prove, cost per simulation stays in check as usage grows, and coverage that extends across the lending funnel and into new loan products.

As the Senior Engineering Manager, Machine Learning Simulations at Upstart, you will lead the team that owns this platform. Today machine learning teams run roughly a thousand simulations a month on it. Your job is to make it production-grade, cut its cost while usage doubles, and open it to Analytics and Finance teams who need the same answers about pricing and portfolio strategy. You will work across machine learning, pricing, product, analytics, and infrastructure teams, many of whom own the logic your platform has to reproduce faithfully.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Own the engineering roadmap for Upstart's marketplace simulation platform, and decide which teams and use cases it serves next
Lead, coach, and grow a team of engineers working across distributed services, offline data pipelines, and large-scale compute
Raise simulation reliability and accuracy to a level teams trust for launch decisions, including automated checks that detect drift between simulated and production results
Reduce the cost of each simulation as usage grows, through smart architecture and compute choices
Extend simulation coverage across the lending funnel and into new loan products, partnering with the teams who own each stage of pricing and decisioning logic
Turn recurring questions from machine learning, analytics, and capital markets partners into self-serve simulation workflows

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management experience
Experience leading engineering teams that build and operate backend platforms or distributed systems in production
Experience delivering platform or infrastructure programs that span multiple teams
Proficiency with some or many of the following: Python, Kotlin, AWS, Kubernetes, Databricks, Spark

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of simulation, backtesting, experimentation, or offline model evaluation systems
Experience supporting machine learning teams or operating MLOps infrastructure, including model inference, workflow orchestration, and offline feature pipelines
Knowledge of lending, pricing, credit risk, or marketplace economics
Ability to treat compute cost and efficiency as an engineering goal alongside reliability
Ability to build shared platforms where partner teams own part of the logic, and to keep those interfaces steady as systems evolve
Experience developing senior engineers and emerging engineering leaders

Position location
This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Time zone requirements
The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

Travel requirements
As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range

$195,300 - $270,400 USD

What You'll Love

At Upstart, our benefits are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.
Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)
Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security
Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements
Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)
Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources
Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)
Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you
Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from
Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs)
Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City (opening Summer 2026!)

For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec.
